prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1161; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute pain and swelling of the left wrist. Imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture, and the examination findings were consistent with that imaging. The mechanism of injury described is entirely plausible for a crash of this type. The patient has no known prior injury to this wrist or the surrounding area. Initial management consisted of immobilization in a splint followed by a structured course of care. Over four visits, treatment followed a typical progression, with pain, swelling, and range of motion improving steadily at each follow-up. Care was tapered as the patient recovered, and no further intervention is currently planned beyond routine monitoring. Billing records reflect single charges for each service provided, with no repeated or duplicate entries. Prognosis for full functional recovery is good, with a return to normal daily activities anticipated once healing is complete.
